name: High School Internships (Facciotti Lab)
what_you_do: Local high school students work on research in a lab. The work is computational and wet-lab. It happens after school and in summer.
who_can_apply: Local high school students. Past interns came from Davis Senior High, Dixon High and Natomas Pacific Pathways Prep.
pay_detail: Pay not stated. Ask the lab.
deadline_text: No application process or dates posted.
how_to_apply: No application process is posted. Use the contact page on the Facciotti Lab site to email the lab with a short note about your interests.
notes: Informal opportunity with no posted process, pay, dates or contact on that page. The lab names a partner teacher at Davis Senior High and lists one current intern, so openings may be rare.
